subject: general
question: As of March 2022, which of the following is the highest motorable pass in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** Umling La**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Umling La

__
 
• Umling La is the highest motorable pass in India as of March 2022. It is located in Ladakh, close to Demchok, and lies on the ridgeline between Koyul Lungpa and the Indus River. Umling Pass was awarded the Guinness World Record in 2021 for being the world's highest motorable road. Khardung La, Chang-La, and Lanak La are also mountain passes located in Ladakh, but Umling La is currently the highest among them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khardung La**:

 
 
• In the Leh district of Ladakh, there is a mountain pass called Khardung La.
 
• The pass links the valleys of the Indus and Shyok rivers and is located on the Ladakh Range, north of Leh.
 
• It serves as the entrance to the Nubra valley, which leads to the Siachen Glacier.
 
• The pass's motorable road was constructed in 1976 and made accessible to public motor vehicles in 1988
 
 **Chang-La:**

 
 
• **At 5,391.3024 m**, Chang La is the** highest mountain pass **in Ladakh.
 
• The Chang La is located on the** Leh-Karu-Sakti-Zingral-Chang La-Durbuk-Tangtse-Pangong **Lake motorable route, which connects Leh to Pangong Lake.
 
• **BRO** opened a second alternate** motorable asphalt route** connecting **Zingral and Tangtse **via Ke** La pass and Taruk** in September 2021.
 
 
 
• **Lanak La:**
 
 
• A mountain pass called Lanak La is located in the disputed** Aksai Chin regio**n.
 
• **China **administers it as a part of the** Tibet Autonomous Region.**
 
• It is claimed by India as its **border pass. **
